title: Best of Vietnam in 14 days
summary: Hanoi, one northern landscape, Hue, Hoi An, and Ho Chi Minh City. Fly at least once. Add the Mekong only if you drop a northern night.

days.title: Days 1–3 — Hanoi
days.body: Land and walk the Old Quarter, the lake, and one museum or the Temple of Literature. Eat bun cha.

days.title: Day 4 — Ninh Binh or Ha Long
days.body: Pick one. Ninh Binh for rice and a boat cave. Ha Long for open water. Do not do both unless you add days.

days.title: Day 5 — Back to Hanoi, overnight south
days.body: Return to Hanoi. Fly to Hue the next morning, or board the sleeper train.

days.title: Days 6–7 — Hue
days.body: Citadel, then one tomb. Eat bun bo Hue.

days.title: Day 8 — Hue to Hoi An
days.body: Travel in the morning. The Hai Van pass is optional and weather-dependent.

days.title: Days 9–10 — Hoi An
days.body: Old town, a food morning, and either the beach or My Son.

days.title: Day 11 — Fly to Ho Chi Minh City
days.body: From Da Nang. Use the afternoon to walk District 1.

days.title: Days 12–13 — Ho Chi Minh City
days.body: A museum morning and either Cu Chi or a decision to leave for Can Tho.

days.title: Day 14 — Leave, or a dawn market
days.body: Fly home, or be on a boat in Can Tho if you moved south the day before.

seoDescription: A practical 14-day route from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City, with one northern side trip and the central coast.
